caption: The drawing features three stylized birds arranged vertically on a beige background. The top bird is primarily red with green wings and neck, decorated with black spots on its wings and neck, and has a red beak, green feet, and a white eye with a red ring. The middle bird has a yellowish-brown body, a green tail, green legs, and a green base of the neck and eye area, with red on the head and upper legs, white scales outlined in green on its chest, and a yellow beak. The bottom bird has a green head and tail, a red and green patterned body with some yellow, white wing feathers outlined in brown, yellow legs, and a white eye with a green ring. Each bird is illustrated in a flat, graphic style with simplified shapes and bold outlines. Below the birds, there is printed text: "FROM WOOD CARVING AND BIRTH CERTIFICATES 1782 to 1819." Additional fine print at the bottom notes this as “FOLK ART OF RURAL PENNSYLVANIA PLATE No. 10” and a project reference.
title: Plate 10: From Portfolio "Folk Art of Rural Pennsylvania"
